basis: Endocardial and valvular fibrosis defines this cardiac manifestation; the underlying carcinoid tumour is a separate disease.
Benign tumour arising in the gallbladder; smooth muscle histology does not imply skeletal muscle involvement.
Macroglossia, wall defects and hyperinsulinism define BWS; renal enlargement alone is not injury. [GeneReviews](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1394/)
Defining sequence includes urethral obstruction, renal dysplasia or hydronephrosis, and pulmonary hypoplasia.
SGCE-related myoclonus and dystonia are neurologic; abnormal muscle contractions do not establish intrinsic muscle disease.
Retinal dystrophy, skeletal deformities including scoliosis/hip dislocation, and sensorineural hearing loss each occur in 30-79%; urinary incontinence is <30%.
Necrotizing GN with small-vessel vasculitis in 80-99%; pulmonary hemorrhage <30%; broad skin and respiratory annotations do not establish common tissue damage.
Neoplasm located in a cerebral hemisphere.
Purine synthesis defect with defining encephalopathy and blindness; atrial septal defect in 1/1 reported patient; skeletal abnormalities omitted at four-axis cap.
Cleft palate, congenital heart malformation and intellectual disability define the syndrome; palate belongs to the oral gastrointestinal axis.
ATP1A2-related hemiplegic migraine is neurologic; visual aura and nausea do not establish eye or gastrointestinal damage.
Osteochondrodysplasia with brachydactyly, malformed digits, scoliosis and joint abnormalities; absent skin creases do not establish skin damage.
Congenital aortic arch diverticulum; usually asymptomatic, with insufficient evidence of common lasting airway or oesophageal injury.
Non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability defines a neurodevelopmental disorder.
Defining cranial/clavicular, anal and skin lesions; urogenital fistulas 80-99%, rectourethral 3/7; cap excludes developmental impairment (~57%) and hearing loss (30-79%).
Carcinoma originates in the ovary as a reproductive organ; urothelial resemblance does not establish urinary tract origin or endocrine dysfunction.
Paget carcinoma specifically involves perianal skin; the definition does not establish anal mucosal involvement.
3-M skeletal growth disorder; neonatal distress (~42%) alone does not establish persistent lung injury. [Study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17675530/)
Pure mood disorder; no directly damaged organ within the thirteen axes is established.
Holoprosencephaly and congenital joint contractures define the syndrome; lung hypoplasia/aplasia occurs in 80-99%; renal hypoplasia is <30%.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and optic atrophy define the syndrome; optic atrophy in 3/4; hearing impairment in 1/4 is below threshold.
Severe X-linked intellectual disability; episodic vomiting in 1/3 is a symptom without established gastrointestinal damage.
Capillary-venous vascular malformations located in the leptomeninges define a CNS vascular disorder.
Lateral medullary infarction in the vertebral/PICA vascular territory; dysphagia and speech deficits reflect brainstem damage rather than gastrointestinal injury.
Erythropoietic anemia; liver iron loading ~61% does not establish functional injury in >=30%; skeletal defects uncommon. [Study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32918595/)
